seo.title: Hisob — accounting services in Tashkent for sole traders and LLCs
seo.description: We keep the books and tax records for sole traders and LLCs, file on time, run payroll and prepare you for inspections. A fixed monthly price and a dedicated accountant.
seo.answer: Hisob keeps the books for sole traders and LLCs in Tashkent and remotely across Uzbekistan. Support for a sole trader starts at 800,000 UZS a month, an LLC on the simplified regime from 2,500,000 UZS, and a one-off tax consultation is 500,000 UZS per hour. Every client has a dedicated accountant; we file through the e-cabinet and issue a contract and an act every month.
